title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten documented UCI study settings spanning quiet library floors, reservable rooms, technology-equipped spaces, and the Student Center.

cards.entity_name: Langson Library Fourth Floor Quiet Study Zone
cards.title: Langson Library Fourth Floor Quiet Study Zone
cards.subtitle: Langson Library · fourth floor
cards.notes: Bring materials for focused individual work, silence your phone, and keep conversations outside because this floor is a designated Quiet Study Zone.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet floor in Langson Library for individual reading and writing.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI Libraries designates Langson Library's fourth floor as a Quiet Study Zone and directs users to turn off cell phones and take conversations outside.
cards.access_notes: Library access and hours apply; UCI Libraries lists this as a Quiet Study Zone.

cards.entity_name: Langson Library Basement Quiet Study Zone
cards.title: Langson Library Basement Quiet Study Zone
cards.subtitle: Langson Library · basement
cards.notes: Use this designated quiet zone for sustained reading or drafting; switch devices to silent and move any conversation outside the study area.
cards.short_summary: A quiet-study option below the main levels of Langson Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI Libraries lists the Langson Library basement among its designated Quiet Study Zones.
cards.access_notes: Library access and hours apply; phones should be off and conversations taken outside.

cards.entity_name: Langson Library Third Floor Study Areas
cards.title: Langson Library Third Floor Study Areas
cards.subtitle: Langson Library · third floor
cards.notes: Set up here when working with classmates or when a little background sound is workable; the library designates these areas for group study.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor group-study area where conversation is permitted.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI Libraries identifies Langson Library's third-floor study areas as a designated group-study area for students seeking background noise or group work.
cards.access_notes: Use the Study Space Locator to check availability; this is a group-study area rather than a quiet zone.

cards.entity_name: Langson Library Third Floor Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Langson Library Third Floor Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Langson Library · third floor
cards.notes: Reserve a room through the Study Space Locator before meeting; use the enclosed setup for a defined group session and clear out at reservation end.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group rooms in Langson Library with varying room sizes.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI Libraries states that Langson Library's third floor has group study rooms of various sizes and directs users to the Study Space Locator.
cards.access_notes: Reservations are required through the Study Space Locator; library study-room policies apply.

cards.title: Nordstrom Honors Study Room
cards.subtitle: Langson Library · fourth floor
cards.notes: Ask the Check Out Desk about entry before settling in; this fourth-floor room is specifically available for Honors students.
cards.short_summary: An Honors-student study room on Langson Library's fourth floor.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI Libraries says the Nordstrom Honors Study Room is on Langson Library's fourth floor and is available for Honors students through the Check Out Desk.
cards.access_notes: Available to Honors students; speak with a Check Out Desk staff member for use information.

cards.entity_name: Science Library Fourth Floor Quiet Study Zone
cards.title: Science Library Fourth Floor Quiet Study Zone
cards.subtitle: Science Library · fourth floor
cards.notes: Choose this floor for uninterrupted individual work, keep your phone off, and take conversations outside in line with the library's quiet-zone guidance.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet-study floor in Science Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI Libraries designates the fourth floor of Science Library as a Quiet Study Zone.
cards.access_notes: Library access and hours apply; phones should be off and conversations taken outside.

cards.entity_name: Science Library Sixth Floor Quiet Study Zone
cards.title: Science Library Sixth Floor Quiet Study Zone
cards.subtitle: Science Library · sixth floor
cards.notes: Use the sixth floor when you need a quiet individual-work setting; prepare materials before you arrive and keep conversations outside the zone.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet-study floor in Science Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI Libraries designates the sixth floor of Science Library as a Quiet Study Zone.
cards.access_notes: Library access and hours apply; phones should be off and conversations taken outside.

cards.title: Science Library Honors Study Room
cards.subtitle: Science Library · fifth floor
cards.notes: Confirm access with the Check Out Desk, then use the fifth-floor Honors room for a focused session with your course materials.
cards.short_summary: An Honors-student study room on the fifth floor of Science Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI Libraries lists an Honors Study Room on the fifth floor of Science Library and directs users to the Check Out Desk for information.
cards.access_notes: Speak to a Science Library Check Out Desk staff member for use information.

cards.title: MRC SL Room 173
cards.subtitle: Multimedia Resources Center · Science Library
cards.notes: Reserve SL 173 for a small project group that needs a whiteboard, desktop, projector, and HDMI-connected display; bring valid UCI identification.
cards.short_summary: A reservable MRC room equipped for collaborative media and presentation work.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI Libraries describes MRC SL Room 173 as having a table, seven chairs, whiteboard, desktop, overhead projector, and flat-screen TV with HDMI cable.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to currently enrolled UCI students, faculty, and staff with valid UCI ID; reserve through the MRC study-space system.

cards.title: Courtyard Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: UCI Student Center
cards.notes: Reserve a study room online when your work benefits from campus Wi-Fi, a whiteboard, power, and nearby restrooms in the Student Center.
cards.short_summary: A Student Center study lounge with reservable rooms and practical work amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The UCI Student Center offers online study-room reservations for the Courtyard Study Lounge and lists campus Wi-Fi, whiteboards, power, and nearby restrooms.
cards.source_title: UC Irvine Student Center & Event Services
cards.access_notes: Reserve a study room online; the Student Center lists building hours of 7:00 a.m.–midnight daily, excluding university holidays.
